description: This Java source file defines utility methods for handling SparkplugB MQTT Payload Metrics, including conversion between protocol buffer metrics and internal representations, creation of metrics, validation of metric values, and a nested File class for handling file data within metrics.

classes.name: SparkplugMetricUtil.File
classes.description: A nested class representing a file with a filename and byte content, used for file-type metrics.

methods.name: fromSparkplugBMetricToKeyValueProto
methods.description: Converts a SparkplugB protocol buffer Metric to a KeyValueProto, handling different data types and null values.

methods.name: createMetric
methods.description: Creates a SparkplugB Metric protobuf message with specified value, timestamp, key, data type, and alias.

methods.name: addToMetricValue
methods.description: Adds a value to an existing Metric protobuf message based on the specified data type.

methods.name: getTsKvProtoFromJsonNode
methods.description: Creates a TsKvProto from a JSON node and timestamp.

methods.name: getTsKvProto
methods.description: Creates a TsKvProto from a key, value, and timestamp, inferring type from the value.

methods.name: validatedValueByTypeMetric
methods.description: Validates and extracts the value from a KeyValueProto based on the expected metric data type.

methods.name: validatedValuePrimitiveByTypeMetric
methods.description: Validates and converts primitive types from a KeyValueProto based on the metric data type.

methods.name: validatedValueJsonByTypeMetric
methods.description: Validates and converts JSON string values to appropriate byte arrays or objects based on metric data type.
